expected_design_context: globally distributed single species Tribulus cistoides
island and continental herbarium flower measurements
petal length or source-native flower-size measurement
climate variables or join keys only where supplied by the source
claim_boundary: This source can test within-species island-continent floral divergence and context heterogeneity. A single widespread species is not a second independent cross-lineage effect system, petal length is not pollinator effectiveness or effective dependency, and island-continent differences do not by themselves identify pollinator-driven causation.
